verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party API for creating datasets, triggering eval runs, or reading eval results. The closest items are adjacent: webhooks that can feed external scoring, a request-query REST endpoint, and a user exporting requests to build a fine-tuning dataset. These are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
